topics.title: Government Funding and Artistic Controversy - Graphic Imagery
topics.summary: Senator Jesse Helms seeks to establish standards for government-funded artwork, objecting to depictions deemed inappropriate including a young girl’s photo, urination scenes, and an elephantine penis. The debate centers on the definition of ‘art’ and whether it should be supported with public funds amidst concerns about offensive imagery presented in Robert Maplethorpe's photographs.

topics.title: Dice Clay Discusses Ticket Sales and the Nassau Coliseum
topics.summary: Andrew Dice Clay discusses upcoming ticket sales for his August 7th show at the Nassau Coliseum, emphasizing the venue’s design to minimize distractions during performances and reveals details of a new movie featuring explicit scenes with multiple love interests including Jessica Hahn.

topics.title: Hostage Situation & Mr. Ed Bit - Jessica Hahn
topics.summary: During a discussion about potential military action regarding a hostage situation in Iran, Howard plays a comedic bit featuring Jessica Hahn and Mr. Ed following her mother’s death, expressing frustration with listener criticism and acknowledging the sensitivity of the topic while questioning his humor's understanding.

topics.title: Leona Helmsley Trial & Radio Speculation
topics.summary: During a Grand Central Radio broadcast, hosts discuss Leona Helmsley’s ongoing legal troubles and her attempts to reduce advertising agency commissions. They make outlandish claims about Helmsley's potential first menstruation and bizarre scenarios involving urine consumption, alongside discussions of Donald Trump and artwork disputes – all with little apparent logic.

topics.title: Howard Stern Discusses Inclusion in Comedy List
topics.summary: During a radio segment, Howard Stern reacts to being named on a list of influential comedians, expressing surprise and annoyance at the recognition while questioning the criteria for inclusion. He discusses his humor's influence and engages in a brief conversation about Lori Neff’s role promoting him.

topics.title: Howard’s List Misunderstanding
topics.summary: During a discussion about an influential figures list, Howard repeatedly misinterprets comments and believes others are criticizing Bill Murray. He expresses frustration with being included while simultaneously praising Murray's humor, ultimately highlighting his feelings of inadequacy and self-promotion amidst chaotic conversation and tangential remarks.
